remarks: Welcome to the Kingwood, a beautifully cared for 55+ community. This sun-filled unit features a spacious bedroom with large closets and full bath. Living Room and Dining Area opens to Kitchen with Granite Counters and Breakfast Bar. Recent updates include new flooring, appliances and granite counters. Freshly painted - it's completely turnkey. Enjoy generous closet space, private storage, same floor laundry and assigned parking (#69). The HOA covers, heat, AC, water and electricity for easy, stress free living. Community amenities includes a fitness center, media room, lounge with fireplace, pool table and an outdoor grilling patio. Conveniently located near I-95, public transit, downtown Stamford, restaurants and more! Comfortable, convenient and ready to welcome you home!
